blogs.title: Unlocking the H100: How Asynchrony is Revolutionizing LLM Inference Speed
blogs.description: Most developers tune algorithms, but our new research dives into the uncharted world of GPU hardware asynchrony. We'll break down how FlashAttention-3 splits workloads between 'producers' (loading data) and 'consumers' (doing math) to hide latency, allowing us to achieve 75% utilization on NVIDIA's H100 chips—up from 35% with previous versions. Learn how 'ping-pong scheduling' keeps your GPU cores busy while data is in transit.

blogs.title: Precision vs. Performance: Getting Away with FP8 for Massive Contexts
blogs.description: Lowering precision from FP16 to FP8 usually means sacrificing accuracy, especially for large models with 'outlier' values. Our paper introduces two clever math tricks—block quantization and incoherent processing (using random matrices to spread out outliers)—that let us cut numerical error by 2.6x compared to standard methods. Discover how we fuse these low-precision operations into a single kernel to nearly double throughput without losing model intelligence.

blogs.title: The Softmax Bottleneck: Reducing the Math Between Matrix Multiplications
blogs.description: In standard attention pipelines, the 'softmax' calculation acts like a speed bump, forcing the GPU to wait idly while frequent matrix multiplications pause. FlashAttention-3 restructures the entire algorithm into a two-stage pipeline that overlaps these operations. We explain how we trick the hardware into running slow exponential functions simultaneously with fast matrix multiplications, effectively turning a sequential bottleneck into a parallel stream and squeezing out a massive 1.5–2x speedup.
